definitions.explanation: A state of being happy or fortunate.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せを{祈|いの}っています。
{家族|かぞく}と{一緒|いっしょ}にいると{幸|しあわ}せです。
examples.english: I'm happy when I'm with my family.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{元気|げんき}に{遊|あそ}んでいるのを{見|み}ると、{幸|しあわ}せな{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: Watching the children play energetically makes me feel happy.
examples.notes: Na-adjective usage: {幸|しあわ}せな{気持|きも}ち

notes:
{幸|しあわ}せ means happiness, good fortune, or blessing. It functions as both a noun and a な-adjective.

USAGE:
- As noun: {幸|しあわ}せを{願|ねが}う (to wish for happiness)
- As な-adjective: {幸|しあわ}せな{時間|じかん} (happy time)
- As predicate: {幸|しあわ}せです (I am happy)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {幸|しあわ}せになる: to become happy
- {幸|しあわ}せを{感|かん}じる: to feel happiness
- ご{多幸|たこう}を{祈|いの}ります: I wish you happiness (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幸福|こうふく}: happiness (more formal)
- {喜|よろこ}び: joy
- {嬉|うれ}しい: happy, glad (emotional state)

NOTE:
Alternate kanji: {仕合|しあわ}せ, {倖|しあわ}せ (less common).
